title: page_height() subtracts 6 but draw_messages subtracts 2: off-by-4
description: page_height() returns (terminal_height - 6).max(1). draw_messages() uses visible_height = area.height.saturating_sub(2) where area.height = terminal_height - 4. So page_height gives terminal_height-6 but draw_messages actually shows terminal_height-4-2 = terminal_height-6 lines. These happen to be equal — this is NOT a bug in magnitude, they are consistent. Noting this for completeness; see KITH-hqrw.17 for the real scroll clamp issue.
